'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[2021 Taliban offensive]], [[Battle of Lashkargah]]
****The [[Taliban]] captures the [[Provinces of Afghanistan|provincial]] capitals of [[Lashkargah]], [[Chaghcharan]], [[Puli Alam]], [[Qalati Ghilji]] and [[Tarinkot]], bringing the number of [[Provincial capitals|provincial capitals]] taken in the past eight days to eighteen. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/13/afghanistan-taliban-herat-kandahar-kabul-cities-live-updates (Al Jazeera)]
****Taliban spokesman [[Zabiullah Mujahid]] confirms that the [[Jihadism|jihadist]] group has captured Afghan [[warlord]] [[Ismail Khan]], after the fall of [[Herat]] on Thursday. Footage shows Khan and other officials of [[Herat Province]] in the custody of the Taliban. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-commander-ismail-khan-captured-taliban-seize-herat-2021-08-13/ (Reuters)]
**[[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2020–2021)|Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan]]
***[[United States Marine Corps|U.S. Marines]] begin arriving in [[Kabul]] to secure the [[Hamid Karzai International Airport]] and evacuate [[Embassy of the United States, Kabul|U.S. embassy staff]] and allied Afghan [[interpreter]]s. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/08/13/taliban-seize-two-key-afghan-cities-as-us-evacuates-embassy-staff.html (CNBC)]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**Eight soldiers are killed and six more are wounded when a [[roadside bomb]] explodes in [[Rafah, Egypt|Rafah]], [[Egypt]]. The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Sinai Province|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/13/egypt-officials-say-militant-attack-kills-8-troops-in-sinai (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli security forces]] launch [[stun grenades]] to disperse a crowd of worshippers who were praying outside the [[Cave of the Patriarchs]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/13/israeli-forces-attack-palestinian-worshippers-ibrahimi-mosque-hebron (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 China floods]]
**Twenty-one people are dead and 6,000 are evacuated as heavy rains impact five [[list of cities of China|cities]] in [[Hubei|Hubei Province]], [[China]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/13/china-cities-declare-rain-red-alerts-as-flood-death-toll (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Russian wildfires]]
**A "[[Public holiday|non-working day]]" is declared in [[Russia]]'s [[Sakha Republic|Sakha]] [[Republics of Russia|republic]], and residents are urged to stay at home as smoke from [[wildfire]]s covers the region. The wildfires in [[Siberia]] are now larger than the combined size of [[Wildfires in 2021|all other wildfires currently burning]] in the rest of the world. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/aug/12/wildfire-smoke-in-siberia-brings-stay-at-home-instruction (''The Guardian'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/International/siberian-wildfires-now-bigger-fires-world-combined/story?id=79422602 (ABC News)]
*The death toll from [[flash flood]]ing in [[Turkey]] increases to 31, of whom 29 died in [[Kastamonu Province]] and two in the city of [[Sinop, Turkey|Sinop]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/death-toll-northern-turkey-floods-rises-27-2021-08-13/ (Reuters)] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] lowers the minimum eligibility age for [[Booster shot|"booster" COVID-19 vaccine doses]] from 60 to 50 years old and expands the booster vaccine campaign to [[healthcare worker]]s, [[prisoner]]s, [[prison warden]]s and some high-risk patients under the age of 50 as part of an effort to protect the population from the highly-transmissible [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-08-13/israel-approves-third-vaccine-dose-for-those-over-50 (Bloomberg News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record 20,365 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, including 5,773 new cases in [[Tokyo]]. It is also the first time that the country has reported more than 20,000 cases since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://jen.jiji.com/jc/eng?g=eco&k=2021081301087 (Jiji Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in South Korea]]
*****[[South Korea]] signs an agreement with [[Pfizer]] to purchase 30 million doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] in 2022 as part of a plan to administer 50 million [[Booster dose|"booster" doses]] of the vaccine. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20210813000692 (''The Korea Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Sri Lanka]]
*****[[Sri Lanka]] announces that beginning on September 15, citizens will be required to show a [[COVID-19 vaccine card|vaccine card]] that states that they have received two [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine doses]] in order to enter [[public place]]s and travel between [[Provinces of Sri Lanka|provinces]]. [https://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/sri-lanka-to-make-covid-19-vaccine-certificates-mandatory-from-sept-15-121081301866_1.html (''Business Standard'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 23,418 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 863,189. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2021-08/13/c_1310125577.htm (Xinhua News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Egypt]]
****[[Egypt]] receives a shipment of 1.7 million doses of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] through the [[COVAX]] initiative, bringing the total number of COVAX-donated doses to 4.3 million. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-covax/egypt-gets-new-astrazeneca-vaccine-batch-via-covax-idUSKBN2FF05M (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
****[[Morocco]] receives their first shipment of 600,000 doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2021/08/343895/morocco-receives-600-000-doses-of-the-pfizer-vaccine-today (''Morocco World News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zambia]]
****[[Zambia]] receives a shipment of 119,200 doses of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] donated by the [[United Kingdom]] through the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/zambia-receives-119-200-astrazeneca-coronavirus-doses/2334270 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Canada]]
****[[Minister of Transport (Canada)|Transport Minister]] [[Omar Alghabra]] announces that [[Canada]] will require [[Vaccination|vaccinations]] for [[Government of Canada|federal public servants]] and [[Air travel|air]] and [[train]] passengers. The mandate is expected to be implemented by the [[Crown corporation]] and other federally regulated businesses and will begin as soon as next month. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/federal-government-mandatory-vaccinations-1.6140131 (CBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
******[[United States Secretary of Education|U.S. Education Secretary]] [[Miguel Cardona]] announces that the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] will offer financial help to schools who defy [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] bans imposed by [[Governor of Florida|Florida governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]] and [[Governor of Texas|Texas governor]] [[Greg Abbott]]. This comes following criticism of DeSantis and Abbott from the Biden administration for banning schools from imposing mask mandates. [https://www.politico.com/states/florida/story/2021/08/13/biden-administration-offers-financial-help-to-florida-school-leaders-defying-desantis-1390026 (''Politico'')]
******Multiple [[Appellate court|appellate courts]] in [[Texas]] uphold the mask mandates imposed in [[Bexar County, Texas|Bexar]], [[Dallas County, Texas|Dallas]], [[Harris County, Texas|Harris]], and [[Travis County, Texas|Travis]] [[Counties of Texas|counties]] in an effort to override [[Governor of Texas|Governor]] [[Greg Abbott]]'s ban on [[Mask mandate|mask mandates in schools]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/567851-texas-school-districts-key-county-get-temporary-wins-on-masks (''The Hill'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii]]
*****[[Hawaii]] reports a record 1,167 cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.hawaiipublicradio.org/local-news/2021-08-13/health-department-record-high-covid-19-cases-pandemic-david-ige (Hawaii Public Radio)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] surpasses 20,000 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] from COVID-19. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2021/08/covid-stats-for-friday-aug-13-michigan-surpasses-20000-coronavirus-deaths.html (MLive)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Missouri]]
*****[[Governor of Missouri|Missouri governor]] [[Mike Parson]] announces that around 500,000 residents have entered the [[Missouri|MO]] VIP program, which incentives [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States|vaccination against COVID-19]]. [https://www.kmbc.com/article/missouri-says-almost-500000-entered-states-covid-19-vaccine-incentive-program/37305923 (KMBC-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
*****[[Germany]] reclassifies the [[United States]], [[Israel]], [[Turkey]], [[Kenya]], [[Montenegro]] and [[Vietnam]] as "high risk" COVID-19 areas, triggering mandatory 10-day [[quarantine|quarantines]] for unvaccinated travellers unless they can show a negative [[COVID-19 testing|test]] after five days. The changes will be in effect from August 17 for Turkey and from August 15 for the rest of the countries. [https://www.dw.com/en/covid-germany-labels-us-israel-turkey-high-risk-areas/a-58860000 (Deutsche Welle)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 815 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 168,864. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/13/russia-reports-record-high-covid-19-deaths (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Andrew Cuomo sexual harassment allegations]]
**The [[New York State Assembly]] says that they will suspend [[Impeachment|impeachment investigations]] of outgoing [[Governor of New York|governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] once he resigns on August 24. [https://apnews.com/article/andrew-cuomo-new-york-impeachments-f3ab4342f645cc604f7d6e20c28b796b (Associated Press)]
*[[Samsung]] chairman [[Lee Jae-yong (businessman)|Lee Jae-yong]] is released from prison in [[South Korea]] after his parole was announced on Monday. Lee served seven months out of a 30 month imprisonment sentence that had been imposed on him for [[Corruption in South Korea|financial corruption]]. Lee addressed journalists, saying that he will do "his best" from now on and apologizing for his crime. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20210813-jailed-leader-of-s-korea-s-samsung-walks-free-in-latest-early-release-for-business-elite (France 24)]
*[[National Police of Nicaragua|Nicaraguan police]] raid the offices of [[Newspapers in Nicaragua|national newspaper]] ''[[La Prensa (Managua)|La Prensa]]'' after the government announces an investigation into allegations of [[Customs|customs fraud]] and [[money laundering]] by its directors. ''La Prensa'' had published several critical stories against current [[President of Nicaragua|president]] [[Daniel Ortega]], whom they have called a "[[dictator]]" numerous times. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/nicaraguan-police-raid-la-prensa-newspaper-charge-directors-with-fraud-2021-08-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[Political impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**Opposition lawmakers in [[Argentina]] present a formal [[impeachment]] against [[President of Argentina|President]] [[Alberto Fernández]] for violating [[COVID-19_pandemic_in_Argentina#Government_responses|COVID-19 restrictions]] after a photo surfaced of a party that he held in 2020 while the country was under a strict quarantine. Opposition party leader [[Patricia Bullrich]] called for Fernández's removal as [[2021 Argentine legislative election|mid-term elections]] approach. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentine-opposition-lawmakers-try-impeach-fernandez-success-unlikely-2021-08-13/?fbclid=IwAR3WQ-35wGQ1ulM6Qm-M9kKi5-NJs_f3jWKG0mnanNdsq62nM_Dg06ozpP0 (Reuters)]
